content.comment_body: When building a page in [product_name], I know it can be accessed via PC browser when connected directly to the [product_name] controller with Ethernet, or by mobile browser using WiFi. However, I want to reach a [product_name] web page using mobile internet (4G), not WiFi. Is this possible? Can anyone guide me on where to start, or suggest some helpful manuals?

This isn't an issue with the controller itself, but rather with your local network setup. To access it remotely, you'll need a VPN server at home (not third-party VPN services) and a DDNS service if you don't have a static IP address from your provider (which is usually expensive). For detailed instructions on setting this up, check specialized forums. Best regards, [user_name]
[company_name] released [product_name] version [version_no] with support for cloud features. You can use cloud services from providers like AWS for remote access through any 4G mobile device.
Possible solutions: 1. Use a VPN for your network. 2. Use [product_name] with its cloud feature. 3. Combine [product_name] with a communication module for remote access.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking to access [product_name] web pages remotely over mobile internet (4G) instead of traditional Ethernet or WiFi connections. The main usability issue is that remote and cloud access capabilities for [product_name] are not clearly documented, leading to confusion. There is awareness of LAN/WiFi access, but users are looking for simple, intuitive mobile solutions without complex network setup.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect easy access to [product_name] web pages from anywhere using mobile data, without having to set up advanced IT or networking. They hope for a straightforward and user-friendly solution, or clear instructions on how to enable remote access functionality.
